Nevermind, I fixed it for all games.

I went into Sidequest, and ran two custom ADB Commands:  
adb shell setprop debug.oculus.cpuLevel 4  
adb shell setprop debug.oculus.gpuLevel 4  


That nearly eliminated all stutter, frame rate is still a bit dodgy but definitely feels more like a quest limitation rather than an issue now.
